# HOLD FIRE take two: sound design (cue sheet)

*Generated by `tools/audio/sfx_t2.py` (re-run after any timing or edit change: every time below is read from the edit itself by `tools/audio/t2_events.mjs`; this run: node tools/audio/t2_events.mjs (live from render/src/timeline.js)). Do not edit by hand.*

## What it is

A light layer, only where the picture makes a sound and the song leaves room: the chess clock in the bridge, the two VHS rewinds, the match after the cold-open rewind, the sonar and depth charges under 'sixty-two', and the reset counter in the outro. Same rules as take one (`docs/SOUND.md`):

* **The song is untouched**: mix = song + layer, sample-aligned; outside the cue windows the layer is exactly 0, so the mix is bit-identical to the song there (null test below). No normalising, ducking, compression or limiting of the song.
* **Under the song**: each cue sits at a target median margin under the song's momentary loudness (BS.1770, 400 ms) and never closer than its worst-frame margin; overlaps are checked on the summed layer.
* **Under the vocal**: wherever a word sounds (vocal stem >= -40 LUFS in 50 ms windows, within 12 dB of the word's peak) the whole layer sits >= 6 dB under the vocal (fitted at 7); event cues take a lower gain, the rewinds and the counter duck under the words with a smoothed gain curve on the layer only.
* **Loudness unchanged**: integrated loudness within 0.01 LU of the song (here +0.0073 LU, after a common -2.0 dB trim on the layer).
* **All synthesized** (numpy/scipy, seeded, deterministic); take one's match, sonar and depth-charge synths are reused.

## The clock

42 presses, one per clock press of `render/src/scenes/t2/chess/schedule.js` (the start press 143.423, then each ply's press by the hand that moved, on the sixteenth after it lands (an eighth for moves 5-6), the last 21.Kxg2's on 'hand' 157.482; 21...Qg4+ is not pressed, and the clocks stop on 'let' 158.101 without a press). Drums out until 153.694: there the slaps are the rhythm (one level for the phase; measured median 17.9 dB under the song); once the drums return they drop back (median 22.3 dB under). Jade (White) is panned left and a little rounder; teal-tips (Black) right, harder and brighter. 9.Qxg7 on 'spark' gets +2 dB and a few spark ticks (the sparks off the clock). Every slap is also held 7 dB under the sung bridge vocal where it lands in a word, so the levels below vary press by press.

Sound: palm thump (LP noise 260/320 Hz, 11 ms) + plastic button click (BP 1.8-8.5 kHz, 2-2.6 ms) with button modes (1.34/2.27/3.41/5.08 kHz x side ratio 1.00/1.07) + wooden case knock (205/330/515/770 Hz, 22-55 ms) + the rocker toggling over 8-13 ms later + the other button popping up at 18-26 ms; +-2.5% mode jitter per press; small dark room (RT60 0.45 s, -15 dB).

## Cues

Margins in dB: *song* = song momentary minus cue (median / worst, the worst on the summed layer); *vocal* = vocal stem minus the summed layer in 50 ms frames where a word sounds (median / worst; `-` = no word under the cue).

### How each is made

* **vhs_coldopen**: synth: transport hum (48->140 Hz x 6 harmonics, LP 1.8 kHz) + gear whine (520->1670 Hz) + friction hiss (BP 1.4-7.5 kHz) + scrape squeal (1.35->3.25 kHz, pitch = scrub speed, falls with the 110 ms brake) + scan chatter; wow 0.7 Hz, flutter 14 Hz; engage and brake clunks (modes 96-620 Hz); small desk room RT60 0.55 s
* **match**: take one's match_strike(): grainy BP noise scratch; crack + pop; flare = noise through SVF low-pass 9 -> 1.5 kHz; flame body; trimmed to 0.75 s (the burn fades under 'One'); ducks under the whisper, so the scratch in the silence is heard whole and the flare blooms as the word allows
* **sonar1**: take one's sonar_ping(): D6 sine + 8% 2nd, 4 ms attack, 90 ms hold, slight down-chirp (second +6 cents: closer), muffled echo +0.36 s; here a longer sea (RT60 2.6 s, LP 2.2 kHz, -4 dB)
* **thud1**: take one's depth_charge(): sine boom 95 -> 38 Hz + LP-noise body + muffled crack, bubble pulse +0.28 s, all LP 600 Hz
* **vhs_build**: synth: as the cold-open rewind; speed = -d(war clock)/dt from the BU05/BU06 p(t) (rwClock), LP 5 Hz inertia, normalised at 3.6x; brake 140 ms into the stop clunk
* **counter_resets**: synth: steel click + 3-4 detent clicks 5-9 ms apart + panel knock (modes 142-655 Hz) + faint ring (1.8-4.2 kHz), +-1 dB per reset; ticks = detent click + 2.55/3.9 kHz modes at -13 dB; cinder-block wall RT60 0.4 s
* **counter_roll**: synth: roller ticks swelling +3 dB, carries doubled with a 420/690 Hz knock; a light clunk as the wheels land

## Timing notes

* Cold open: the rewind starts on the sub hit 7.160 and runs to the stop on the floret 8.316 (`t2_vhs_rewind` rewind 1 -> 0.12); the transport brakes over the last 110 ms so the squeal's pitch falls into the stop clunk; then silence until the match (scratch in the gap, flare on the CO11 cut).
* Build: the whir follows the war clock's scrub speed (peak 8.7x) and stops on 'Earth whole' 173.876; the slow drift after it (no smear) is silent.
* Sonar: pings in the quietest vocal 20 ms near the BR14 cut and 'sixty-two|depth': 158.604, 159.637. Thuds on the drawn detonations (drop + detAt): 160.176, 160.422, 160.841; skipped (they go off after the cut to 'two said fire' or too close to it): 161.151, 161.293, 161.596. Everything ends by 161.18.
* Counter: 29 resets 224.801-228.212, roll 228.272-229.479 up to 42 ('higher' 229.439). The value depends on the release date (counter.js `release`): re-run after changing it.

## Files

* `tools/audio/sfx_t2.py` (this layer; imports `tools/audio/sfx.py`), `tools/audio/t2_events.mjs` (the picture's events, read-only).
* `media/audio/hold_fire_t2_mix.wav`: PCM 24-bit, 48 kHz stereo, the song's length. For take two render with `node render/tools/render.mjs ... --audio media/audio/hold_fire_t2_mix.wav` (without `--audio` render.mjs picks `media/audio/hold_fire_mix.wav`, take one's mix, if it exists).
* `work/sfx_t2/`: `events.json`, `sfx_t2_layer.wav`, `stems/<cue>.wav`, `cues.json`, `verify.json`, `cue_levels.png` (ear proxy).
